name: Report
prompt: Create an HTML document/report. Structure with a top `<header>` (containing title and metadata). Use `<section>` blocks for content. Integrate `<div class="summary-box">` for executive summaries or key takeaways with an absolutely positioned `.summary-label`. VOCABULARY/PHRASAL VERBS: When listing vocabulary or phrasal verbs, use `<section class="section-break">` and a `<div class="section-header">` with a `<span class="count-label">`. For Phrasal Verbs specifically, you MUST provide these 4 data points: 1) The Phrasal Verb, 2) The Definition (keep it concise, ideally 10-15 words), 3) A single-word English Latinate synonym, and 4) The % of time it's used vs the non-PV & the Impact on the message. Wrap items in `<div class="grid-3">` and define CSS `.grid-3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 16px; }` so that vocab and phrasal verbs span 3 columns. Format this data cleanly inside `<div class="card">` elements. ICONS: ONLY use premium, modern inline SVGs (like Lucide outline icons). NEVER use emojis. TEXT CONSTRAINTS: Keep definitions and explanations concise, but don't artificially break grammar just to hit a strict word count. Professional document layout suitable for printing.
